direction_comparison.direction: Conservation atelier portrait with the robe displayed on a separate mannequin
direction_comparison.assessment: The motif would be legible but the light figures and garment would belong to different owners; weaker unified human presence.

direction_comparison.direction: Contemporary performance portrait inside an engineered light installation
direction_comparison.assessment: Chosen. A single performer joins stitched turtle-snake imagery, a circular head nimbus, and an enclosing pointed-almond mandorla in one physical frame.

chosen_concept_ko: 북극의 봉합: 의복의 자수와 빛의 윤곽이 한 공연자를 잇는 드레스 리허설
who: A fictional adult performer, age 28; visible facial and bob-hair appearance drawn from the supplied portrait; steady and quietly magnetic camera awareness.
where: A contemporary black-box theater costume-and-light installation, using a wearable stitched emblem and two engineered stage light forms.
how: Frontal full-figure editorial photograph at an unhurried distance; face, large chest emblem, and complete light outlines remain simultaneously readable.
why_now: The performer gently draws the robe side seams outward just as the light installation is aligned, turning a fitting into a still performance.
historical_scope: Fictional contemporary stage artwork; no claim that the combined costume and light forms describe an actual historical sect, ceremony, or person.
reference_scope: Visible face, eyes, and dark chin-length bob with wispy fringe only. Fictional adult age is authored staging, not an inference about the reference person.
